metadata.title: Critical Point Theory for the Distance Function on PL-Spaces
metadata.abstract: We study the (typical) singularities of the distance function from a point in the ambient space to a polytopal complex in Euclidean space. By means of the Goresky-MacPherson splitting we generalize the existing linear theory to the quadratic distance function. Critical points occur on `selected' strata of the PL-space, where normal Morse Data determine the change of topology. On the homology level there exist indices with multiplicities, combined in a Morse vector. We focus mainly on PL-manifolds. We give bounds, depending on the dimension of the strata. In low dimensions we describe singularity types. At the end we discuss relations with Discrete Morse Theory.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 研究欧氏空间中点到多胞复形的平方距离函数的典型奇点及临界点引起的拓扑变化。
analysis.breakthrough: 把已有线性理论推广至二次距离，并给低维奇点类型与维数界。
analysis.limitations: 主要聚焦 PL 流形；一般复形的完整分类不在摘要中。 本条数学解读依据官方摘要与评论；论文全文尚未作数学审读，AI 披露另行核查。
analysis.priorityReason: 按几何相关性、结果新颖性、技术可复用性及摘要证据清晰度综合评分 53/100；重点在于把已有线性理论推广至二次距离，并给低维奇点类型与维数界。
